vcmi.wiki.glossary.aom-norse.town.name: Norse: Warband, Favor and God Powers
vcmi.wiki.glossary.aom-norse.town.descri:
{Norse} (aom-norse) is the town of the Norse from Age of Mythology. Its troops and heroes revolve around three mechanics: the {Einherjar Warband}, {Favor} and {God Powers}; the town itself also has the {Ages} and the {Giant Hearts}.

## Einherjar Warband
When a hero of a Norse class leads an army, the whole army has the Einherjar Warband. At the start of each round formations are worked out again from where the troops stand, lasting that round:

| Formation | Condition | Effect |
|------|------|------|
| {Shield Wall} | A stack of the Berserker or Throwing Axeman lines with at least one stack of these two lines directly in front, behind or beside it | Ranged damage taken -15% |
| {Svinfylking} | Allies stand on both diagonal hexes behind a stack (toward your own side) | Melee damage +20% |

### Valhalla
Your fallen troops count toward {Souls} by their health, and enemy troops you kill by half their health. Each time a full step of souls is stored (hero level × 60), a stack of {Einherjar} is recalled, up to 3 times per battle; the 1st, 2nd and 3rd recalls need hero level × 60, × 90 and × 120. Deaths caused by spells and battlefield effects do not count.

### Odin's Wain
At the start of battle, one star lights for each level of Norse creature in the army (1-7 stars, summons not counted), and each star gives souls +5%. If enough stars are lit (7; with Warband Oath 7 at Basic, 6 at Advanced, 5 at Expert), {Ragnarok} triggers once from round 7: your Norse troops deal +30% damage that round, and one more stack of Einherjar is recalled (not counted toward the limit of 3).

[![Warband Oath](aom/nor/skills/aomNorOath_basic_82.png)](wiki:skill/aom-norse:aomNorOath)

- Racial skill {Warband Oath}: formation effects ×1.25, ×1.5, ×2; souls +20%, +40%, +60%; stars needed for Ragnarok 7, 6, 5.
- Town buildings: {Valhalla} halves the souls needed for recalls in sieges; the {Gjallarhorn} stores half a step of souls at the start of siege battles; towns in the Mythic and Wonder Ages give +10% souls when defending; the Grail building {Yggdrasil} makes the Big Dipper light 2 more stars and gives souls +25% for all your Norse heroes.
- The hero Odin's specialty stores souls faster and brings one more stack on the first recall of each battle; the combined artifact {Asgard Hoard} gives souls +50% and lights 1 more star at the start of battle.

## Favor
The specialty of eight heroes, Forseti, Tyr, Freyja, Hel, Angrboda, Ullr, Vidar and Sigurd, is {Favor}: Favor +1 at the start of each round, +1 more if your side acted in the previous round, and a boon at 2, 4 and 7 points, each once per battle, triggered automatically.

| Favor | Boon |
|------|------|
| 2 points | The specialty troops gain {Divinity} for 2 rounds: attacks ignore 15% of the target's Defense |
| 4 points | Differs by hero, see below |
| 7 points | By patron god: Thor gives all enemies Defense -4, Odin gives your army Morale +1 and Attack +2, Loki gives all enemies Attack -3, all for 2 rounds; Freyr heals all your living troops 30% of their health |

The 4-point boons: Forseti heals Northern Trolls to full health; Tyr gives Fimbulwinter Wolves Attack +6 for 2 rounds; Freyja heals all your living troops 20% of their health; Hel gives Tundra Titans +25% damage for 2 rounds; Angrboda makes Krakens take 50% less damage this round; Ullr gives Throwing Axemen +30% ranged damage for 2 rounds; Vidar gives Fafnirs Attack and Defense +4 for 2 rounds; Sigurd lets Viking Berserkers attack one more time this round.

## God Powers
The Norse Mage Guild holds 16 extra {God Powers}:

- Level 1: [Spy Eye](wiki:spell/aom-norse:aomNorSpyEye)
- Level 2: [Dwarven Armor](wiki:spell/aom-norse:aomNorDwarfArmor), [Undermine](wiki:spell/aom-norse:aomNorUndermine)
- Level 3: [Great Hunt](wiki:spell/aom-norse:aomNorGreatHunt), [Forest Fire](wiki:spell/aom-norse:aomNorForestFire), [Flaming Weapons](wiki:spell/aom-norse:aomNorFlameWeapons), [Healing Spring](wiki:spell/aom-norse:aomNorHealingSpring)
- Level 4: [Golden Boar](wiki:spell/aom-norse:aomNorGoldenBoar), [Frost Prison](wiki:spell/aom-norse:aomNorFrost), [Walking Woods](wiki:spell/aom-norse:aomNorWalkingWoods), [Hailstorm](wiki:spell/aom-norse:aomNorTempest), [Spectral Bastion](wiki:spell/aom-norse:aomNorBastion)
- Level 5: [Nidhogg](wiki:spell/aom-norse:aomNorNidhogg), [Einherjar Awakening](wiki:spell/aom-norse:aomNorEinherjar), [Fimbulwinter](wiki:spell/aom-norse:aomNorFimbulwinter), [Fenrir's Inferno](wiki:spell/aom-norse:aomNorInferno)

{Affinity}: each Norse hero serves one patron god (Thor, Odin, Loki or Freyr, by class). When a hero casts a god power under their own patron, damage, healing and summoned amounts are +25%, and lasting effects last one round longer. The last line of each god power's description says which patron it belongs to.

[![Soul Offering](aom/nor/skills/aomNorSacrifice_basic_82.png)](wiki:skill/aom-norse:aomNorSacrifice)

Racial skill {Soul Offering}: when the hero casts a god power, it spends stored souls (up to 25%, 50% or 75% of a step), raising the spell's effect in proportion, up to +15%, +30% or +45%; spent souls no longer count toward recalls. In the round of Ragnarok, god powers spend no souls and use the cap.

## Ages
When every building of an age is built, the town enters that age automatically, and the first hero to enter the town sees a message. Each age's effects replace the previous one's rather than stacking. Before the first age is reached the town is in the {Archaic Age}, with no bonus.

| Age | Buildings required | Creature growth (weekly) | Other |
|------|------|------|------|
| Classical Age | Tavern, Fort, Marketplace, Berserker Lodge, Axe Range | Level 1-2 +2 | None |
| Heroic Age | Town Hall, Mage Guild Level 2, Citadel, Blacksmith, Troll Cave, Wolf Den | Level 1-2 +3, level 3-4 +1 | Stack experience +20% |
| Mythic Age | City Hall, Mage Guild Level 3, Castle, Temple of the Gods, Valkyrie Hall, Kraken Fjord or Fafnir Hoard | Level 1-2 +3, level 3-4 +2 | Stack experience +20%; souls +10% in sieges |
| Wonder Age | Capitol, Mage Guild Level 5, Gjallarhorn, Resource Silo, Ginnungagap Gate | Level 1-2 +3, level 3-4 +2, level 5-6 +1 | Stack experience +20%; souls +10% in sieges, defending troops health +10% |

The +20% stack experience applies to all your troops, counted once however many towns you have.

## Giant Hearts
Four giant banks stand in the wild: the Mountain Giant Grotto, the Rock Giant Lair, the Frost Giant Ice Cave and the Fire Giant Lava Rift, each guarded by one kind of giant; taking one yields a {Giant Heart}. A hero carrying a giant heart into a Norse town with the {Jotun Altar} offers it automatically, and the kingdom gains a permanent bonus:

| Giant Heart | Bonus |
|------|------|
| Mountain Giant Heart | Level 1-4 dwellings in Norse towns +1 growth |
| Rock Giant Heart | Troops defending a Norse town with a Fort get Defense +2 |
| Frost Giant Heart | Norse troops take 25% less water spell damage, Norse heroes' water spells +10% |
| Fire Giant Heart | Norse troops Attack +1, Norse heroes' fire spells +10% |

Once all four are offered, level 5-7 dwellings in Norse towns get +1 growth more.

## Gate of the Nine Worlds
Once the Grail building {Yggdrasil} is built, a hero of a Norse class who visits the town learns the special spell {Gate of the Nine Worlds}. It is a level 5 spell that does not appear in Mage Guilds. When cast in battle, the Gate of the Nine Worlds beneath Yggdrasil opens: a Mountain Giant descends to your side at once, then a Rock Giant, a Frost Giant and a Fire Giant at the start of each following round. Each stack has total health Spell Power × 20 (Basic), × 30 (Advanced) or × 40 (Expert), at least 1. It can be cast only once per battle.

## Battering Ram
The town's {Dwarven Armory} builds 2 {Battering Rams} each week, at 900 gold each. In sieges the ram moves to the wall and uses {Ram Strike} on the adjacent gate, wall, tower or keep; it deals double damage to war machines. Rams controlled by the AI walk to the wall and ram it by themselves.

## Other
The commander {Rune Smith} marches with Norse heroes. The war machine {Norse Ballista} is sold at the town's Blacksmith. The combination artifact {Asgard Hoard} is fused from 6 components.
